note: Every value is editable in DASHURI_FINANCIAL_SIMULATOR.html. status: code = read from the implementation; verified = official source on the date given; unverified = partial or third-party source; estimate = no data, reasoned; placeholder = get a quote; decision = founder setting.

assumptions.label: Organic registrations in Month 1
assumptions.source: No install or registration data exists.
assumptions.rationale: A new 18+ video-chat app with no brand and no paid push. 1,200 OTP-verified sign-ups in month one needs active community seeding by the founder.

assumptions.label: Organic registration growth per month
assumptions.rationale: Word of mouth and store ranking compound slowly without paid installs; 15% is a modest base.

assumptions.label: Paid marketing budget per month
assumptions.rationale: Kept equal across scenarios so the scenario gap shows market response, not spend. Set to 0 to test organic only.

assumptions.label: Paid cost per verified registration (CAC)
assumptions.source: No campaign data. Cost per OTP-verified 18+ sign-up, not per install.
assumptions.rationale: Indian social-app installs are cheap, but only ~55–65% of installs finish phone OTP, and 18+ dating/social categories carry ad restrictions that lift CPMs.

assumptions.label: Registrations that pass 18+ and account checks
assumptions.source: Age gate and account checks are implemented (identity module).
assumptions.rationale: Most adults pass; a few are blocked as minors or abandon onboarding.

assumptions.label: Usage spike month (stress test)
assumptions.rationale: 0 = no spike.

assumptions.label: Usage spike: × registrations that month
assumptions.rationale: Used for the 10× usage test.

assumptions.label: Non-paying users still active next month
assumptions.rationale: Free users have only one free call card (single use, no re-issue — D-05), so there is little for them to come back to.

assumptions.label: Daily active ÷ monthly active
assumptions.rationale: Display and infrastructure sizing only.

assumptions.label: Eligible new users who start their free call
assumptions.source: One card per phone and per device (freecall module).
assumptions.rationale: The card is the onboarding hook; not everyone tries a random match.

assumptions.label: Free calls reaching the full 60 s (host is paid ₹10)
assumptions.source: settle.go: compensation only when billable ≥ 60 s.
assumptions.rationale: Random matches are often skipped early.

assumptions.label: Active hosts opted into the free-call pool
assumptions.source: host free_call_opt_in flag; 20 free calls per host per day cap (code).
assumptions.rationale: Caps free-call capacity.

assumptions.label: Free-call users who buy Diamonds in the same month
assumptions.source: No data. The single most important unknown.
assumptions.rationale: 3–9% first-purchase conversion is typical of freemium social apps with a strong first experience; Dashuri has none yet.

assumptions.label: Other new users who buy in their first month
assumptions.rationale: Users who skip the free call rarely pay straight away.

assumptions.label: Active non-payers who first buy in a later month
assumptions.rationale: Slow drip of late converters.

assumptions.label: Paying customers who stop buying each month (churn)
assumptions.rationale: Paid-companionship spend is impulsive and concentrated; most first-time buyers do not return. 45% monthly churn means a payer lasts ~2.2 months on average.

assumptions.label: Diamond purchases per active payer per month
assumptions.rationale: Most payers buy once a month; a few heavy users buy repeatedly.

assumptions.label: Package mix (Starter → Premium)
assumptions.source: Carried from docs/simulation (17 Nov) — hypothesis, no data.
assumptions.rationale: Small packs dominate early in Indian microtransaction apps.

assumptions.label: Shortfall covered by an extra top-up when a payer runs out
assumptions.source: No in-call top-up in the MVP (D-10); the low-balance banner links to the wallet after the call.
assumptions.rationale: Some payers who run out buy again the same month; the rest stop calling.

assumptions.label: Average purchase value vs package mix
assumptions.source: Simulator control: scales package counts toward bigger packs.
assumptions.rationale: 1 = the mix above. 1.5 = buyers spend 50% more per purchase (same ₹ per Diamond).

assumptions.label: Paid call attempts per active payer per month
assumptions.rationale: Set so that Diamonds bought and Diamonds used roughly balance in the base case.

assumptions.label: Call attempts that the host accepts and that connect
assumptions.source: No data. Failed/declined calls are released unbilled (settle.go).
assumptions.rationale: Hosts miss or decline calls; networks fail.

assumptions.label: Average connected paid call length
assumptions.rationale: Short calls dominate pay-per-minute video; 60 s minimum balance to start (code).

assumptions.label: Connected time not billed (pauses ≥ 10 s, host video off)
assumptions.source: Billing follows host video; interruptions ≥ 10 s are not billed (timeline.go).
assumptions.rationale: Mobile networks in India drop often.

assumptions.label: Average host rate
assumptions.source: Range 500–10,000 D/min, default 500 (code). Level ladder unresolved, so hosts may set any rate in range.
assumptions.rationale: Most hosts will price near the low end until demand is proven.

assumptions.label: Call-minute demand response to the per-minute price
assumptions.rationale: A 10% higher ₹/min cuts minutes demanded by ~6% (base).

assumptions.label: Purchase response to ₹ per Diamond
assumptions.rationale: Used only when package prices or sizes change.

assumptions.label: Approved, active hosts at launch
assumptions.rationale: A launch pool the founder can recruit and verify by hand.

assumptions.label: Active hosts who stop each month
assumptions.rationale: High: host earnings are low and payouts are switched off.

assumptions.label: Max share of online time a host can spend in calls
Manual KYC review cost per application
assumptions.rationale: ~20 min of a ₹300/h reviewer, plus re-checks.

assumptions.label: Host earnings vs implemented Bean rule
assumptions.rationale: Use >1 to test a higher host share.

assumptions.label: Purchase value charged back after use (incl. fraud)
assumptions.source: Spent Diamonds cannot be recovered; audited as reversal_shortfall (code).
assumptions.rationale: Stolen cards and friendly fraud on spent value.

assumptions.label: Fee per chargeback case
assumptions.source: Third-party reports of US$15–25 per case passed to developers after 3 Aug 2026 (docs/simulation).
assumptions.rationale: Confirm in Play Console.

assumptions.label: Host Beans recovered on a chargeback
assumptions.source: BeanClawback reverses Beans still in the 7-day hold (ledger templates).
assumptions.rationale: Payouts are off, so held and available Beans are both reachable today.

assumptions.label: GST included in Diamond prices
assumptions.source: Migration: "Prices include GST". 18% on online services (statute).
assumptions.rationale: Who remits GST on Play sales needs CA confirmation.

assumptions.label: Google Play service fee
assumptions.source: 15% on the first US$1M/year (Google help page; India-specific 2026–27 schedule unconfirmed). Conservative uses 20% (reported new non-recurring rate).
assumptions.rationale: Google is changing India fees; check Play Console before launch.

assumptions.label: Play fee charged on the GST-inclusive price
assumptions.source: Unconfirmed; conservative charges on the inclusive price.

assumptions.label: Months until Google pays out a sale
assumptions.source: Google pays merchants around the 15th of the following month (docs/simulation, verified 17 Nov).

assumptions.label: Months until GST is paid
assumptions.source: GSTR-3B due on the 20th of the following month.

assumptions.label: Stream video price per 1,000 participant-minutes
assumptions.source: Stream pricing guide: HD (720p) $1.50, Full HD $3.00 per 1,000 participant-min (checked 22 Nov 2026). Calls are set to 1280×720 (stream.go).
assumptions.rationale: Conservative assumes Stream bills at the Full HD tier (its aggregate-resolution rule).

assumptions.label: Stream free usage per month
assumptions.source: Stream: first $100 of usage free each month (pricing page; wording varies).
assumptions.rationale: Conservative assumes no free tier.

assumptions.label: Unbilled Stream minutes per call (ringing, setup, pauses)
Sightengine price vs published plans
assumptions.source: Sightengine pricing page: free 2,000 ops; Starter $29 / 10k ops; Pro $99 / 40k ops; +$0.002/op (checked 22 Nov 2026).
assumptions.rationale: One nudity check = 1 operation (assumed).

assumptions.label: On-call safety / takedown cover
assumptions.source: IT Rules takedown timelines; grievance officer (integration checklist).
assumptions.rationale: Someone must be reachable every day. ₹0 only if the founder does it personally.

assumptions.label: OTP SMS price
assumptions.source: Twilio India $0.0832/SMS (official page, 22 Nov 2026) = ₹7.4. Base assumes a cheaper Supabase-supported provider (unquoted). Optimistic: Indian DLT gateway via an SMS hook.
assumptions.rationale: The provider is not chosen; get quotes.

assumptions.label: Re-login OTP SMS per active user per month
Supabase Pro plan
assumptions.source: Supabase Pro $25/month incl. $10 compute credit (pricing page).
assumptions.rationale: Free tier pauses idle projects; production needs Pro.

assumptions.label: Cloud Run API + worker at launch
assumptions.source: No load test. One warm instance for webhooks and call evaluation.
assumptions.rationale: Scales with active users (below).

assumptions.label: Other Google Cloud (Secret Manager, Pub/Sub RTDN, logs, registry)
Variable infrastructure per 1,000 active users
assumptions.source: DB compute, storage, egress, Cloud Run scaling.

assumptions.label: Customer support per 1,000 active users
assumptions.rationale: Payment and refund disputes dominate.

assumptions.label: Accounting, GST filings (CA)
assumptions.rationale: Monthly GSTR-1/3B, books, TDS later.

assumptions.label: Other fixed operating costs
assumptions.rationale: Phone, banking, test devices (amortised).

assumptions.label: Founder salary
assumptions.rationale: Excluded by default. Add it to see the true cost of the business.

assumptions.label: One-time setup in Month 1
assumptions.source: Get quotes: incorporation, legal review of terms/privacy/host agreement, trademark, Play developer account (US$25).
assumptions.rationale: Payouts and Cashfree need a company and written approvals.

assumptions.label: Host payouts switched on
assumptions.rationale: Withdrawals are recorded but not paid.

assumptions.label: Withdrawable Bean balance hosts withdraw each month
assumptions.rationale: Hosts withdraw almost everything they can.

assumptions.label: Payout transfer fee
assumptions.source: No payout provider has been chosen.

assumptions.label: Starting cash
assumptions.rationale: Compared with the computed capital requirement.

assumptions.label: Cash reserve to keep (months of fixed cost)
Cut the extra Diamonds on Large and Premium
assumptions.source: Lever. 1 = Large/Premium give the same Diamonds per ₹ as Popular.

assumptions.label: Loyalty bonus: promotional Diamonds as % of purchase
assumptions.source: No promo grants are issued in the MVP (only expiry is coded; 30-day TTL, spent first).
assumptions.rationale: Promo Diamonds earn hosts Beans but bring no revenue.
